svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in PETG at 100 % infill: 30 wide, 50 deep, 30 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm bore 18.4 mm from the back face, 27 mm deep (blind).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drop rod bore 12.4 mm top to bottom, its centre 14 mm in front of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the block's centre, so it passes 6 mm in front of the arm's end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hex pockets and 6.6 mm holes for two M6 thumb screws, one onto

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the arm and one onto the drop rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the end of the arm; the 12 mm drop rod slides up and down

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in it and carries the dial indicator by its lug back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the drop rod stands upright when the arm is level.
